description.zh: 座席工号；取值3-10位正整数
description.en: The agent ID. The value must be a 3- to 10-digit positive integer.

description.zh: 随路数据方向；取值说明：1： 座席侧，2： 非座席侧
description.en: The user data direction. Valid values: `1` (agent side) and `2` (non-agent side).

description.zh: json格式字符串,传入的值会打入通道变量,格式：json字符串{"key":"value"} 随路数据格式：key=value,不支持数组，嵌套。
description.en: The user data, formatted as a JSON string. This value is injected as a channel variable. The format must be a simple key-value map, such as `{"key":"value"}`. Arrays and nested objects are not supported.
